mapper.sql: SELECT i.invoice_id id, c.customer_name customerName, e.employee_name employeeName, i.invoice_date invoiceDate, i.project_name projectName, i.count, i.price FROM t_invoice_form i LEFT JOIN t_customers_master c ON (i.customer_id = c.customer_id) LEFT JOIN t_employee_master e ON (i.employee_id = e.employee_id) WHERE 1 = 1 AND i.invoice_id = #{id}
